verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can ask Ari "why spending went up," which is a period-over-period variance explanation, and Ari traces outputs back to the source line. Ari also proactively reports "what changed," which is flagging, and actuals can be imported from the ledger. However, no evidence shows a structured budget-to-actual variance analysis or what form the explanations take. Missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actual variance reporting, documentation of variance-driver decomposition and explanation depth, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
